name: Ahikam
summary: Ahikam son of Shaphan was one of the men King Josiah sent to ask of the LORD about the book of the law that had been found. Later he stood by the prophet Jeremiah, so that Jeremiah was not handed over to be killed.

key_moments.title: Sent to Huldah the Prophetess
key_moments.description: When the book of the law was found, King Josiah sent Ahikam, Hilkiah the priest and others to ask the LORD what it meant for Judah. They went to Huldah the prophetess, who lived in Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Standing by Jeremiah
key_moments.description: King Jehoiakim had the prophet Urijah brought back from Egypt and killed for speaking against the city. But Ahikam was on Jeremiah's side, so Jeremiah was not given to the people to be put to death.
